summary.zh: 现在完成进行时用于强调某个动作从过去开始，一直持续到现在，或者刚刚结束但对现在仍有明显影响。它的核心不是单纯说明“完成了什么”，而是突出动作的持续性、过程性和当前相关性。在PTE Academic和IELTS中，该时态常用于描述长期趋势、持续研究、个人经历、社会变化以及图表中的连续发展。中国学习者需要特别注意：现在完成进行时通常与for、since、recently、lately、over the past few years等时间表达搭配，不能与明确的过去时间点如yesterday、in 2019单独连用。

structure.explanation: 现在完成进行时由助动词have或has、过去分词been以及动词-ing形式构成。主语为I、you、we、they或复数名词时使用have been；主语为he、she、it或单数名词时使用has been。该结构强调动作从过去延续到现在，或动作虽刚结束但结果仍影响现在。否定形式为Subject + have/has not been + V-ing；疑问形式为Have/Has + subject + been + V-ing?

examples.en: Researchers have been examining the relationship between sleep quality and academic performance.
examples.zh: 研究人员一直在考察睡眠质量与学业表现之间的关系。

examples.en: She has been preparing for the PTE speaking section for three months.
examples.zh: 她已经为PTE口语部分准备了三个月。

examples.en: Have you been using academic vocabulary in your essays?
examples.zh: 你一直在作文中使用学术词汇吗？

usage_scenarios.title: 强调从过去持续到现在的动作
usage_scenarios.description: 当一个动作在过去某个时间开始，并且到现在仍在进行时，使用现在完成进行时。该用法常与for和since搭配。for后接一段时间，since后接起点时间。

examples.en: Many students have been studying online for several years.
examples.zh: 许多学生已经在线学习了好几年。

examples.en: The university has been expanding its research facilities since 2020.
examples.zh: 这所大学自2020年以来一直在扩建其研究设施。

usage_scenarios.title: 强调最近一段时间反复发生的行为
usage_scenarios.description: 当某个行为在最近一段时间内频繁或反复发生，并且与当前情况相关时，可以使用现在完成进行时。常见时间表达包括recently、lately、these days和over the past few weeks。

examples.en: I have been reading more academic articles recently.
examples.zh: 我最近一直在阅读更多学术文章。

examples.en: Consumers have been spending more on digital services lately.
examples.zh: 消费者最近一直在数字服务上花费更多。

usage_scenarios.title: 解释现在可见结果的原因
usage_scenarios.description: 如果某个动作刚刚结束或仍在进行，并导致现在能看到的结果，可以使用现在完成进行时。该用法强调“为什么现在会这样”。

examples.en: The ground is wet because it has been raining all morning.
examples.zh: 地面是湿的，因为整个上午一直在下雨。

examples.en: He looks exhausted because he has been working on his dissertation all night.
examples.zh: 他看起来很疲惫，因为他整晚都在写论文。

usage_scenarios.title: 描述长期趋势或持续变化
usage_scenarios.description: 在IELTS写作Task 1和PTE Summarize Written Text中，现在完成进行时可用于描述从过去延续到现在的趋势、变化或发展过程，尤其适合表达动态变化而非静态事实。

examples.en: The proportion of renewable energy use has been increasing steadily over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去十年中，可再生能源使用比例一直在稳步上升。

examples.en: Urban populations have been growing rapidly in many developing countries.
examples.zh: 许多发展中国家的城市人口一直在快速增长。

common_mistakes.wrong: I am studying English for three years.
common_mistakes.correct: I have been studying English for three years.
common_mistakes.explanation: 中文学习者常用现在进行时直接表达“已经持续多久”，但英语中如果动作从过去持续到现在，应使用现在完成进行时，而不是am/is/are doing。

common_mistakes.wrong: She has been learn English since 2021.
common_mistakes.correct: She has been learning English since 2021.
common_mistakes.explanation: 现在完成进行时中的主要动词必须使用V-ing形式。been后不能接动词原形learn，应改为learning。

common_mistakes.wrong: They have been working here yesterday.
common_mistakes.explanation: 现在完成进行时不能与明确的过去时间点yesterday单独搭配。如果强调昨天发生的事情，应使用一般过去时。

common_mistakes.wrong: The number of international students has been increased recently.
common_mistakes.correct: The number of international students has been increasing recently.
common_mistakes.explanation: has been increased是被动结构，意思是“被增加”，通常不适合描述数量自然上升。若强调趋势持续上升，应使用has been increasing。

common_mistakes.wrong: I have been knowing him for five years.
common_mistakes.correct: I have known him for five years.
common_mistakes.explanation: know、believe、own、understand等状态动词通常不用于进行时。表达“认识某人多久”应使用现在完成时，而不是现在完成进行时。

common_mistakes.wrong: Have you been finished your essay?
common_mistakes.explanation: finish强调完成结果，通常用现在完成时。现在完成进行时强调过程，如Have you been working on your essay?表示“你一直在写作文吗？”

pte_usage.description: 现在完成进行时在PTE中常出现在口语复述、写作总结、听力填空和阅读理解中。它适合表达持续研究、长期变化、近期趋势和个人备考经历。在PTE Speaking的Describe Image中，考生可用该时态描述图表中从过去延续到现在的增长或下降趋势；在Summarize Written Text中，可用它概括研究、政策或社会现象的持续发展；在Essay中，它能帮助考生写出更自然的因果分析和背景陈述。

academic_patterns.pattern: Researchers have been investigating whether + clause.
academic_patterns.translation: 研究人员一直在调查是否……

academic_patterns.pattern: The government has been implementing policies to + verb.
academic_patterns.translation: 政府一直在实施政策以……

academic_patterns.pattern: The data have been showing a gradual increase in + noun.
academic_patterns.translation: 数据显示……一直呈现逐渐上升的趋势。

academic_patterns.pattern: Scholars have been debating the extent to which + clause.
academic_patterns.translation: 学者们一直在讨论……在多大程度上……

academic_patterns.pattern: More attention has been being paid to + noun.
academic_patterns.translation: 越来越多的关注一直被放在……上。

academic_patterns.pattern: Companies have been investing heavily in + noun.
The population has been shifting from + noun + to + noun.
Educators have been exploring new ways to + verb.
academic_patterns.translation: 教育工作者一直在探索……的新方法。

collocations.phrase: have been working on a project
has been studying for the exam

collocations.translation: 一直受到相当多的关注

collocations.phrase: has been contributing to economic growth

ai_tips: 如果句子中出现for、since、over the past few years，并且动词强调“持续做某事”，优先考虑现在完成进行时。
写PTE或IELTS作文时，使用has/have been V-ing可以让背景描述更有动态感，例如强调社会现象一直在发展。
不要把所有“已经”都翻译成have been doing；如果强调结果或次数，应使用现在完成时，例如I have finished three essays.
图表题中描述持续趋势时，可以用has been rising、has been falling、has been fluctuating，但要避免与具体过去时间点直接连用。
状态动词通常不用现在完成进行时；表达长期状态时使用现在完成时，如The issue has existed for decades.

practice_questions.question: 用现在完成进行时改写句子：I started preparing for IELTS two months ago, and I am still preparing now.
practice_questions.answer: I have been preparing for IELTS for two months.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确句子：A. She has been worked on her essay since Monday. B. She has been working on her essay since Monday.
practice_questions.answer: B. She has been working on her essay since Monday.

practice_questions.question: 判断并改错：The unemployment rate has been increased over the past year.
practice_questions.answer: 错误。应改为：The unemployment rate has been increasing over the past year. 这里描述失业率持续上升的趋势，应使用现在完成进行时主动结构。

practice_questions.question: 翻译：在过去十年中，越来越多的学生一直在选择在线课程。
practice_questions.answer: Over the past decade, more students have been choosing online courses.

practice_questions.question: 填空：Researchers ______ ______ ______ the impact of social media on teenagers. 使用have/has been + V-ing。
选择合适时态：I have known / have been knowing this professor for five years.
practice_questions.answer: I have known this professor for five years. know是状态动词，通常不用进行时。

practice_questions.question: 用现在完成进行时造句，表达“这个城市最近一直在改善公共交通”。
practice_questions.answer: The city has been improving its public transport system recently.

practice_questions.question: 改写为疑问句：They have been conducting research on climate change.
practice_questions.answer: Have they been conducting research on climate change?
